field.label: Batch Size
field.comment: Number of products processed per internal batch/transaction. Default: 500.

field.label: Continue On Error
field.comment: If a batch fails, roll it back and continue with the next batch instead of aborting the request.

field.label: Auto-Create Missing Attribute Options
field.comment: Create select/multiselect option values that do not exist yet.

field.label: URL Rewrite Conflict Strategy
field.comment: What to do when a generated URL key is already taken by another entity.

field.label: Enable Attribute Definition Sync
field.comment: Allow the /V1/readydata/attributes endpoint to create/update product attribute definitions

field.label: Enable Category Sync
field.comment: Allow the /V1/readydata/categories endpoint to create/update categories. Off by default: it reshapes storefront navigation and category URLs.

field.label: Allow Category Moves
field.comment: Allow a payload that names parent_path/parent_category_id to reparent a category. Off by default: a move re-paths the whole descendant subtree and regenerates every URL under it (old URLs 301 when Create Permanent Redirect is on).

field.label: Allow Category Deletion
field.comment: Allow a payload that sets "delete": 1 to remove a category. Off by default: deletion is recursive and irreversible, taking the descendant subtree, its URL rewrites and its product assignments with it. Products themselves are never deleted.

field.label: Product Category Replacement Reaches
field.comment: How far the PRODUCT payload's "categories" field reaches when it replaces a product's assignments. Whole Catalog (default) removes every link the payload does not list. Only the Roots the Payload Names removes links only under the root categories the payload's own entries resolve into, leaving other root trees alone — the setting for a catalog whose root trees are fed by different sources. A payload may override this per product with "categories_replace_scope".

field.label: Enable Media Gallery Import
field.comment: Import the "media" block of the product payload. Off: media is skipped entirely, including image downloads.

field.label: Download Timeout
field.comment: Seconds to wait for a single image download. Default: 15.

field.label: Download Concurrency
field.comment: How many images to download at once. 1 is fully sequential (the escape hatch if an origin rate-limits). Default: 4, maximum 32. Each in-flight download holds up to 2 MB in memory before spilling to disk, so this setting multiplies the transfer-time memory footprint.

field.label: Maximum File Size (KB)
field.comment: Largest accepted image. Default: 10240 (10 MB).

field.label: Allowed File Extensions
field.comment: Comma-separated extensions accepted for downloads and for pre-uploaded paths. SVG is deliberately absent: it can carry script.

field.label: Allowed Download Hosts
field.comment: Comma-separated host allow-list for image URLs. EMPTY MEANS ANY HOST, which lets a compromised feed make the store fetch arbitrary URLs it can reach, including internal ones. Set it in hardened environments.

field.label: Re-Download Existing Files
field.comment: Re-fetch a URL even when its target file already exists, replacing it when the bytes differ. Off (default) makes re-imports do zero network I/O; publish a changed image under a new filename or replace the file out of band instead.

field.label: Auto-Assign Media Roles
field.comment: When a "media" block declares no roles and the product has no image role yet, point image/small_image/thumbnail at its first enabled entry. swatch_image is never auto-assigned.

field.label: Reindex Mode
field.comment: Partial: reindex only imported products (recommended). Invalidate: mark indexers invalid for cron. None: do nothing.

field.label: Clean Cache For Imported Products
field.comment: Flush FPC/block cache tags for touched products only.

field.label: Dispatch Product Save Events
field.comment: Re-emit catalog_product_save_commit_after (and the readydata_import_* events) after each imported batch so third-party observers react to imports.

field.label: Also Dispatch catalog_product_save_after
field.comment: Additionally fire catalog_product_save_after per product, inside the batch transaction. Slower and heavier than the commit-after events above, and a throwing observer rolls the whole batch back. Only enable if a third-party observer must run on this in-transaction event. The native URL-rewrite/inventory observers are suppressed during import either way. Requires "Dispatch Product Save Events".

field.label: Include Media Gallery In Dispatched Events
field.comment: Read each dispatched product's media gallery and image roles from the database (two extra queries per batch) so observers see the same media_gallery, getMediaGalleryImages() and getMediaGalleryEntries() data a loaded product has. Applies to every product in the batch, including ones whose payload carried no "media" block, and is independent of "Enable Media Gallery Import". Leave off if a third-party observer calls $product->save(): a populated gallery makes Magento's gallery save handler run. Requires "Dispatch Product Save Events".

field.label: Enabled
field.comment: Writes to var/log/readydata_import.log
